column5: The live nested-loop RIGHT path preserves the right/outer relation scan order for both matches and left-NULL-extended misses, and uses the shared TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN status fold so ON UNKNOWN remains a nonmatch. Go hash-table build-side choice, partition workers, nullable/all-key serialization, selection vectors, chunk capacity, and physical row copying remain open.

Session execution now consumes one RIGHT outer-row contract for ON and USING/NATURAL joins: TRUE emits left+right rows, FALSE/UNKNOWN preserve the right row with a NULL left side, and output stays in right-side scan order. Go Joiner cloning, inline projection, required-row chunking, physical build/probe variants, and allocator/spill behavior remain open.
